summary.text: Mike Gierau is a Democratic member of the Wyoming State Senate for District 17 who took office in January 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 16 from 2017 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Mike Gierau represented Wyoming House District 16 from 2017 to 2019 before moving to the state Senate on January 7, 2019, succeeding Leland Christensen.
He was a superdelegate to the 2016 Democratic National Convention and supported Hillary Clinton for the nomination.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Senate Appropriations Committee, the Senate Rules and Procedure Committee, the Senate Journal Committee and the Management Council Committee, among others.
